title: VIX futures & options November 2026 expiration (SOQ settlement) — lands two sessions before this monthly expiry, sharing its morning with the October FOMC minutes
source: EST: CBOE'S OWN SETTLEMENT SURFACE, FETCHED DIRECT 2026-09-09 by the opex-2026-11-20 pulse-check adjacency sweep — www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv (plain curl, HTTP 200 after a 301, 1,731 bytes, 56 rows) carries the row `VX,VX/X6,2026-11-18,19.1354`, and the Mini contract mirrors it at `VXM,VXM/X6,2026-11-18,19.1354`. The contract is LISTED and CARRYING A DAILY SETTLEMENT PRICE, which is the exact promotion trigger the sibling ledger vix-expiration-2027-11-17 named for its own unlisted VX/X7. Independently re-derived from the venue's rule rather than read off the file: Cboe's VX final-settlement clause is the Wednesday 30 days prior to the third Friday of the month immediately following the contract month, displaced to the preceding business day if either leg is an exchange holiday. December 2026's third Friday is 2026-12-18 (2026-12-01 is a Tuesday, so the Fridays are 04, 11, 18); the Wednesday 30 days prior is 2026-11-18; neither 2026-11-18 nor 2026-12-18 is a closure (Thanksgiving 2026 is 2026-11-26), so the displacement clause does not fire. A third, weaker corroboration sits inside this calendar already: the confirmed vix-expiration-2026-09-16 entry's own source line records Cboe's next listing applying the same rule unchanged — VX/V6 to 2026-10-21, thirty days before 2026-11-20. Filed ESTIMATE not for want of evidence but per this lane's no-self-confirm limit — the sweep that discovers an event may not confirm it, only that event's own initial research may, exactly as vix-expiration-2026-09-16 was flipped by its own session on 2026-09-04. PROMOTION IS ONE FETCH AWAY: re-read the same settlement surface and cite the VX/X6 row. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the opex-2026-11-20 pulse check (2026-09-09, D-72), proposed because it is the sharpest hole this session found in the November corridor. On 2026-08-19 that ledger's initial research recorded ZERO tracked events within five days of 2026-11-20 and called the window 'comparatively empty'; the corridor now holds 27 without this entry, every one of them added to the calendar after that row, and this settlement was still not among them — the sibling opex-2026-10-16 sweep, which proposed the October settlement the same day off the same Cboe fetch, explicitly left November and December for 'a later sweep… on its own evidence'. It matters to an opex ledger for one structural reason the sibling vix-expiration-2026-09-16 already wrote down: the volatility complex's own expiration is STAGED AHEAD of the equity one, so 'the gamma rolls off Friday' understates when the cushion actually starts leaving. Here the stagger is two sessions — VIX futures/options AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation (VRO) built from opening-auction trade prices of a single SPX/SPXW series exactly 30 days out (the 2026-12-18 series), with the expiring contract ceasing trading 09:00 ET on 2026-11-18, and the equity monthly then prints at the 2026-11-20 close. Its session is already crowded: fomc-minutes-2026-11-18 (medium, confirmed — the October-28 decision's minutes, and the November corridor's only rate catalyst, since there is no November FOMC), apec-leaders-shenzhen-2026-11-18 (medium, estimate), treasury-20y-bond-2026-11-18, housing-starts, pending-home-sales and tic-monthly, all on 2026-11-18. The corridor is ALREADY PAID FOR in the term structure, from the same fetch: VIX cash closed 15.72 on 2026-09-08 while VX/X6 settles at 19.1354 and VX/V6 at 18.402 — a monotone contango whose steepest single step is the September-to-October one (+1.77), i.e. the market pricing the 30-day window that ends at the 2026-11-20 expiry and contains midterm-elections-2026-11-03, us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10 and cpi-2026-11-10. Independent cash cross-check the same day: VIX3M closed 18.39 against that 18.402 future. Impact LOW, matching every other vix-expiration entry, and symbols empty: trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped this session for opex/expiration/witching/settlement/SOQ and return zero hits in both, so no house playbook is expiration- or settlement-keyed. An estimate widens caution and licenses nothing.
